name: Li Canxue
source:
Li Canxue is another former magical girl who formed a trio with [url=/c93493]Lisette[/url] and [url=/c93492]Circe[/url] during the initial C.C. invasion. Her feats during the Lunar Orbit Battle were second only to Lisette herself.

She continued fighting the C.C. after the Lunar Orbit Battle, but was killed in the line of duty three years after the Cathedral's founding.

[From [url=https://deadendaegis.com/#4]official website[/url]]
